T9 WebSocket消息interact权限检查已完成(commit 6c03804+2ff2792):
1. 远程代理路径：forward_client_to_remote中解析JSON，拦截input_result/confirm_result/manual_interrupt，无interact权限则返回FORBIDDEN错误并continue跳过转发
2. 本地代理路径：包装websocket.receive_text为_checked_receive_text，拦截同三种消息类型，无权限则返回FORBIDDEN并递归等待下一条
3. 权限检查逻辑：非system用户+非owner+无access_acl.interact+无agent:delete权限=拦截
4. owner和system用户不受限

T10 前端permissionSchema更新已完成(commit 5d3733d):
- AdminPanel.vue L289: agent权限从['*','create','read','execute','delete']简化为['*','create','delete']
- 与后端BUILTIN_GROUPS简化一致
